description: We’re sudo chmod 777 crew, a few SE students who think Mars needs a better map. We’re building an interactive one for the Interplanetary Survival Guide challenge and could use more hands. Web dev, design, data viz, writing: if you’re good at any of that, jump in. Bonus points if you’ve touched Leaflet or NASA’s Mars data, but no pressure. Beginners welcome. We’ll figure it out together (probably with a lot of Stack Overflow).
